review_candidates.description: The Edge & Network Services (ENS) team at Meta is looking for individuals ready to tackle the challenges and opportunities we face as we contribute to our mission of connecting the world. This global team offers a unique career opportunity to work alongside engineers solving complex problems using cutting-edge network infrastructure technologies. For this role, we are looking for a Network Infrastructure Design Engineer with demonstrated experience in developing and delivering network infrastructure solutions at scale in a data center or globally distributed Point of Presences (POPs).Are you ready to shape the future of Meta's global network reach? As a member of the ENS Foundation Design team, you will support capacity expansion of Meta’s global Edge/Backbone network and compute presence. You will work closely with cross-functional design, planning, and deployment teams to develop space, power, cooling, and connectivity infrastructure design requirements and drive execution of these needs within Meta’s global colocation spaces including POPs, Cable Landing Stations, and Backbone midpoint sites. This role is execution and delivery focused supporting the North America and Latin America regions.Join us in this exciting endeavor and make a real impact on Meta's future! Network Engineer, Foundation and Support (Edge/Backbone Infrastructure Design) Responsibilities: Designs, reviews, and optimizes ICT physical infrastructure — including structured cabling systems, floor/rack layouts, network hardware placement, and integrated communications systems — for large-scale data center and network deployments Develops and enforces Meta ICT design standards, best practices, and compliance with relevant industry standards (e.g., TIA/EIA, ISO/IEC, BICSI) Develops optimized layouts of edge/backbone midpoint site floorplans, allocates space assigned to network functions, optical, backbone, IP, and compute Delivers on time Engineering Design Packages related site infrastructure scope for sourcing and capacity planning teams Manages global space, power, cooling, structured cabling, and other inside plant infrastructure delivery requirements to support Meta edge/backbone network deployments across owned and colocation facilities Engages in system level facility sizing of utilities, switchgear, UPS/DC power plant, PDUs, mechanical cooling, and Low Voltage power distribution Proactively engages with various data center colocation providers in evaluating their facilities and recommends corrective actions to meet Meta standard design requirements Collaborates with internal and external design and planning engineers to execute projects related to cage and suite network/compute infrastructure build-outs Leads weekly syncs with external colocation vendors and provides technical support and progress reporting on cage and suite build-outs and acceptance Manages and tracks project timelines, risks, and successfully navigate projects to on-time completion Leads site acceptance activities with various colocation providers as per Edge network facility acceptance standards Coordinates multiple projects in parallel and efficiently executes work through vendors at scale Collaborates closely with Meta business and technical teams to provide input on space/power delivery and associated deployment projects, as well as other major initiatives that may affect capacity delivery Updates Meta’s internal tooling and data record keeping in support of edge/backbone midpoint cage and suite build-outs Coordinates related Owner Furnished/Contractor Installed equipment delivery from Meta’s inventory to colocation facilities Proactively works and aligns with network planning and investment teams on the roadmap and material forecasting needs for on-time delivery of projects 20% to 30% travel required based on project demand Minimum Qualifications: Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta 5+ years of work experience with designing and constructing large scale data center or similar mission critical infrastructure including specifying suite level space, power, cooling, and structured cabling connectivity requirements for network and compute hardware Demonstrated experience in project management, including planning, execution, and delivery of complex technical projects Working knowledge of interpreting and analyzing electrical/mechanical single line diagrams Working knowledge of various regional data center electrical and cooling configurations, IEC, NEMA standards, AC/DC power concepts, power redundancy scenarios General knowledge of fiber optic components, structured cabling, pathways, and interconnect products, technologies, and design concepts Demonstrated understanding of engineering principles related to infrastructure architecture, including space line up, air flow, cooling, etc General knowledge of data center, colocation, and isolated hut environments, including engineering principles related to power and infrastructure Demonstrated experience with field-based work in POPs, data centers, Carrier-neutral facilities, or telecom exchanges Experience with communication and directing tasks with carriers and colocation vendors Demonstrate experience to work effectively in an ambiguous environment Collaborate with global teams to drive business results. Must possess proven planning, prioritization, and communication skills, with the experience to manage multiple tasks and adapt to changing business needs Proven skill to analyze technical situations, troubleshoot issues, and solve problems with limited supervision Working knowledge of internet networking technologies (TCP/UDP, DHCP, DNS, routing, switching concepts), optical transport technologies (DWDM and Optical transceivers), and network redundancy and failover concepts Working knowledge of Revit/AutoCAD/Bluebeam/BIM360/ACC/Procore etc Preferred Qualifications: Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Proficient in Revit/AutoCAD/Bluebeam/BIM360/ACC/Procore etc Thorough knowledge of optical theory, transport technologies, and the operation of optical transport systems and IP backbone network technologies Experience with optical network design, installation, and maintenance for service providers or global enterprise networks Experience with ICT design and construction administration for hyperscale data centers and global backbone network capacity enablement p Data center design or relevant structured cabling design certifications (eg. review_candidates.title: Consultant System & Network Engineering (all genders)
review_candidates.description: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Beratung & Presales: Du unterstützt bei Akquise‑ und Presales‑Aktivitäten und führst technische Workshops bei unseren Kundinnen und Kunden durch. Projektumsetzung: Du planst und konsolidierst Netzwerk‑ und Datacenter‑Konzepte und setzt diese im Enterprise‑Umfeld um. Architektur: Du entwickelst technische Zielarchitekturen unter Berücksichtigung von Security, Hochverfügbarkeit und regulatorischen Anforderungen. Technische Projektverantwortung: Du übernimmst temporär die technische Leitung von Projekten und führst IT-Assessments sowie Reviews durch. Hands‑on Engineering: Du arbeitest aktiv bei Projekten in komplexen Netzwerk‑ und Infrastrukturumgebungen mit und löst technische Herausforderungen pragmatisch. DEIN PROFIL Qualifikation: Du hast ein Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung abgeschlossen. Erfahrung: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Praxis im IT‑Consulting und im System‑ oder Network‑Engineering mit Datacenter‑Bezug. Technologie‑Know‑how: Du bist sicher im Microsoft-Infrastruktur-Umfeld (z. B. Active Directory, Entra ID, Windows Server), kennst dich mit Juniper- und Cisco-Netzwerken (Routing, Switching) aus, hast solides Firewall-Know-how (Design, Betrieb, Troubleshooting) und Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung, Backup/Recovery und Hybrid-Cloud-Anbindungen. Architektur Betrieb & Regulierung: Du konzipierst stabile Netzwerk- und IT-Architekturen, verstehst IT-Security und unterschiedliche Betriebsmodelle. Idealerweise sind dir regulatorische Anforderungen wie BAIT, KAIT, VAIT, ZAIT, DORA oder NIS2 bereits vertraut. KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

review_candidates.title: Spécialiste en Automatisation des Infrastructures TI
review_candidates.description: We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Specialist to support the development, implementation, and maintenance of automation solutions for our IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for developing tools and processes that improve the efficiency, consistency, and reliability of infrastructure operations. Working closely with infrastructure, operations, security, architecture, and cloud teams, you will automate deployments, standardize processes, and support ongoing operational requirements. Your future duties and responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance automation tools, scripts, and workflows. Automate the deployment and management of virtual infrastructure. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. Build and support CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or equivalent tools. Develop automation using PowerShell and Python. Identify opportunities to improve and automate operational processes. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to automation and infrastructure deployments. Participate in system deployments, upgrades, patching, and change implementation. Ensure automation solutions meet operational, performance, and security requirements, including vulnerability remediation. Work with infrastructure, cloud, security, and architecture teams to implement automation solutions. Create and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role 2–4 years of experience in infrastructure automation, DevOps, systems administration, or software development. Bilingual (French/English) Strong experience with PowerShell. Experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). Experience developing automation using Python. Experience with CI/CD tools, including GitLab or equivalent. Understanding of DevOps practices and automation principles. Knowledge of routing and switching technologies (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent experience). Experience with firewall technologies, including Fortinet and Cisco. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Experience supporting virtualized infrastructure environments. Experience working with cloud technologies. Knowledge of infrastructure security and vulnerability management. Experience working in enterprise IT environments. CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $60,000–$110,000. This role is a future opportunity. Spécialiste en Automatisation des Infrastructures TI Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste en automatisation des infrastructures TI passionné par l'amélioration continue des environnements technologiques. Vous contribuerez à la conception, à l'implantation et à l'évolution de solutions permettant d'automatiser les opérations, de simplifier les déploiements et d'assurer la fiabilité des plateformes. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'amélioration des pratiques d'infrastructure en développant des solutions d'automatisation robustes, évolutives et sécuritaires. Vous participerez également à la modernisation des processus d'exploitation en favorisant les approches DevOps et Infrastructure as Code. Vous collaborerez avec différentes équipes techniques, notamment les équipes d'exploitation, d'architecture, de sécurité et d'infonuagique, afin de livrer des solutions performantes répondant aux besoins de l'organisation. Your future duties and responsibilities Développer et maintenir des outils d'automatisation pour les opérations TI. Concevoir des scripts et des processus automatisés afin d'améliorer l'efficacité des environnements virtuels. Déployer et gérer des infrastructures à l'aide de Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). Participer à la conception, à l'optimisation et au maintien de pipelines CI/CD. Automatiser les activités de déploiement, de configuration et de gestion des environnements. Identifier, analyser et résoudre les problèmes liés aux solutions d'automatisation. Participer aux activités de déploiement, de mises à niveau et de gestion des changements. Veiller à la qualité, à la performance et à la sécurité des solutions développées, incluant la correction des vulnérabilités. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus opérationnels et des pratiques DevOps. Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire des solutions développées. Collaborer avec les différentes équipes TI afin d'assurer l'intégration harmonieuse des solutions. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role Vous possédez un fort intérêt pour l'automatisation, les infrastructures modernes et les pratiques DevOps. Vous aimez résoudre des problèmes complexes, optimiser les processus et travailler dans un environnement collaboratif. Qualifications Requises Minimum de deux (2) à quatre (4) années d'expérience pertinente en automatisation, développement ou infrastructure TI. Excellente maîtrise de PowerShell. Expérience avec Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). Expérience en développement avec Python. Expérience avec des outils CI/CD, notamment GitLab ou un équivalent. Bonne compréhension des pratiques DevOps, de l'automatisation et du déploiement continu. Connaissance des technologies de routing and switching (niveau CCNA ou CCNP ou expérience équivalente). Connaissance des technologies de pare-feu, notamment Fortinet et Cisco. Capacité à documenter les solutions et à partager les meilleures pratiques. Maîtrise intermédiaire de l'anglais (selon les besoins de l'environnement). Atouts Expérience dans la gestion d'environnements virtuels. Expérience avec des infrastructures infonuagiques. Connaissance des pratiques de sécurité et de gestion des vulnérabilités. Expérience dans l'automatisation d'infrastructures à grande échelle. Le calcul de cette fourchette dépend de divers facteurs, notamment le niveau de compétence, le marché géographique, l’expérience, la formation ainsi que les licences et certifications professionnelles. Les décisions en matière de rémunération dépendent des particularités de chaque cas. Une estimation raisonnable de cette fourchette salariale se situe entre 60 000 $ et 110 000 $. review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Bureau is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join the Network Sustainment team. The team delivers project outcomes that enhance the Bureau’s network capability and maintain the lifecycle of critical infrastructure across a geographically distributed environment. Network Sustainment works closely with the Network Operations team to ensure changes are designed for reliability and supportability, and to collaborate on operational issues when required. This role is responsible for end-to-end technical delivery, from early scoping and solution design through implementation, validation, and transition to operations. The role involves both hands-on physical work and logical configuration. The position suits a solution-oriented engineer who can identify constraints early, develop practical options, and provide clear recommendations that balance risk, cost, standards, and operational impact.

review_candidates.title: Vice President of Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Job title: Vice President of Infrastructure Job type: Perm Salary: $195,000 to $260,000 base plus performance bonus (DOE) Role Location: Florida (Hybrid or Onsite) preferred. Remote considered nationally for the right leader. The company: Signify Technology is retained on a confidential search for a Vice President of Infrastructure. Our client is an established organization running a mixed estate of on-premise, colocation, and cloud infrastructure, and they are hiring an executive to consolidate it under one strategy and one leader. This seat owns the systems the whole business runs on, reporting into the CIO or CTO, with authority over the roadmap, the vendor relationships, and the team. Because this is a confidential search, the client is named on a first conversation. Senior leaders who would like to understand the opportunity before formally applying are welcome to reach out directly and we will handle the conversation discreetly. Role And Responsibilities Own the enterprise infrastructure strategy and multi-year roadmap across compute, storage, network, and data center. Lead and grow the infrastructure, network, and systems engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and development. Own the infrastructure budget, including capital planning, refresh cycles, and total cost of ownership. Set the direction for hybrid infrastructure and drive the workload strategy between on-premise, colocation, and cloud. Own availability, capacity planning, and disaster recovery, including business continuity testing. Lead data center operations, consolidation, or exit programs as the strategy requires. Own enterprise networking, including WAN, SD-WAN, and connectivity to cloud providers. Partner with Security to harden the estate and meet audit and compliance obligations. Own vendor, carrier, and hardware relationships, including contract negotiation and renewals. Drive automation and modern operations practices to reduce manual work and unplanned outages. Job Requirements 10 or more years in IT infrastructure, with 5 or more years leading infrastructure teams at manager, director, or above. Proven ownership of an enterprise infrastructure strategy and its capital and operating budget. Deep, hands-on background across compute, storage, virtualization, and enterprise networking. Experience running hybrid environments spanning on-premise or colocation and at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Demonstrated ownership of a data center consolidation, migration, or exit program. Strong grounding in disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability design. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Track record of building, leading, and retaining a technical team. Legally authorized to work in the United States. Benefits Competitive base salary plus performance bonus Medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with employer match Paid time off and paid holidays Executive ownership of the infrastructure function, its roadmap, and its budget A team you build and lead directly A clear modernization mandate with executive backing behind it Accessibility Statement: We make an active choice to be inclusive towards everyone every day. review_candidates.title: Technisch Specialist netwerk & infrastructuur
review_candidates.description: Ben je net als wij ook gepassioneerd over de toekomst en potentie van sensordata en AI en vind jij het leuk om te werken op de meest speciale locaties die je maar kunt bedenken? Wil jij meebouwen aan het IT-fundament voor de inzet van drones, camera’s, laboratorium en x-ray scanners? Lees dan vooral snel verder! Dit doe je bij de Douane Als Technisch Specialist netwerk & infrastructuur is het jouw kerntaak om ons sensorennetwerk en de bijbehorende infrastructuur 24/7 veilig en beschikbaar te houden. Als Douane Operaties voeren we op verschillende locaties in ons land actief controles uit om de goederen die Europa en Nederland binnenkomen elke dag weer te controleren. Hiervoor zetten wij verschillende apparatuur in als drones, camera’s, detectiepoorten en x-ray scanners. Het is jouw taak om ervoor te zorgen dat deze apparatuur kan aansluiten op een veilige netwerkinfrastructuur. Jij bent namelijk samen met jouw team verantwoordelijk voor het dagelijkse onderhoud en de inrichting van dit netwerk. Je werkt in het team Sensoren dat onderdeel uitmaakt van de Douane ICT afdeling Data en Digitalisering. Het team bestaat o.a. uit architecten, product owners, business analisten, netwerk-, videocamera-, AI-en data-specialisten. Op de maandag hebben we een team dag in Utrecht, de rest van de week wordt ingevuld door een mix van bezoeken en afspraken op locaties en thuiswerken. Wat jouw werk ontzettend leuk maakt is dat je dagelijks schakelt met enthousiaste Douane collega’s die net als jou de ambities hebben om onze controlewerkzaamheden elke dag weer een stukje beter te maken. Dit doen we mede aan de hand van nieuwe technologische mogelijkheden die we willen inzetten. Zo hebben we als Douane de ambitie om sensordata die uit de controleapparatuur komt, beschikbaar te maken voor analyse, verslaglegging en de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde algoritmes en/of AI-modellen. Hieronder Een Concreet Overzicht Van Jouw Taken En Verantwoordelijkheden Adviseren en ondersteunen van Douane Operaties bij complexe vraagstukken over het inrichten, beveiligen en onderhouden van de netwerkinfrastructuur en draadloze connectiviteit; Beheren van firewalls, WAN-, VPN- en MiFi-omgevingen en het borgen van netwerkbeveiliging; Oplossen van netwerkbeveiligingsincidenten en het uitvoeren van root-cause analyses; Ontwikkelen van monitoring en beheer op afstand; Opzetten, configureren en beheren van netwerkinfrastructuur apparatuur; Monitoren van prestaties, capaciteit en beschikbaarheid en proactief verbeteren waar nodig; Oplossen, analyseren en voorkomen van storingen; Meedraaien in de piketregeling van het team. Een bijzondere baan, omdat... Je er met je team voor verantwoordelijk bent dat onze fysieke controlewerkzaamheden 24/7 doorgang kunnen vinden; Je aan de wieg staat van het nieuw inrichten van onze sensor netwerkinfrastructuur; Je dagelijks bezig mag zijn met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van beveiliging en netwerken; Geen dag gelijk is en je in deze rol dagelijks op de meest interessante plekken komt. Te denken valt bijvoorbeeld aan de Rotterdamse Haven, Schiphol en de haven van Vlissingen. “De Douane zet volop in op nieuwe technologie, zo spelen we binnen ons team een sleutelrol bij de inzet van onze sensoren zoals drones en scanapparatuur. Dat geeft me binnen de Douane veel uitdaging en alle mogelijkheden om mezelf verder te ontwikkelen." Cor, team infra & sensoren Wanneer past deze baan bij je? Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau, een rijbewijs B en overzicht op netwerkinfrastructuur en gekoppelde systemen; Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met het ontwerpen, inrichten, beveiligen en testen van netwerkinfrastructuur; Je hebt kennis van routing, switching, firewalling, netwerkprotocollen, netwerkarchitecturen en data diodes; Je bent in het bezit van een CCNA-certificering (of vergelijkbaar) of bent bereid deze te behalen; Je hebt kennis van securitystandaarden en -principes zoals NIS2, BIO, ABRO, Zero Trust en ISO 27001/27002; Je hebt basiskennis van Microsoft besturingssystemen, storage-oplossingen (SAN/NAS) en camerasystemen; Je hebt interesse in of affiniteit met industriële automatisering en slimme sensoren. Wat vinden we nog meer belangrijk Je hebt een proactieve houding die zichtbaar is in jouw optreden. Je bent communicatief vaardig, enthousiast, flexibel en vakkundig. Je sociale vaardigheden zijn uitstekend en je beweegt je gemakkelijk binnen en buiten jouw netwerk. En omdat integriteit een belangrijke waarde is voor de Douane, is dit in al jouw handelen zichtbaar. Kortom: je bent een plezierige collega en het visitekaartje van de Douane. Jouw competenties analyseren plannen en organiseren voortgangscontrole resultaatgerichtheid samenwerken De afdeling - Douane Directie Informatietechnologie IT Data & Digitalisering (IT D&D) levert producten en diensten op het gebied van data, sensors en bijbehorende functionaliteit om de Douane processen te ondersteunen. Hiermee maken ze het fundament om datagedreven werken mogelijk te maken, zodat waardevolle beslissingen genomen kunnen worden op basis van volledige, juiste en tijdige informatie. Ze verbeteren daarnaast ook de digitale dienstverlening, zodat bedrijven volledig digitaal zaken kunnen doen met de Douane. Het maakt daarbij niet uit via welk kanaal ze in contact zijn met de douane, de gebruikerservaring is uniform en op elkaar afgestemd. De Kerntaken Van IT Data & Digitalisering Zijn Waarde leveren voor de Douane organisatie door IT-applicaties en producten op een snelle, effectieve en breed inzetbare manier te ontwikkelen. Gegevens uit interne en externe bronnen actueel en in samenhang beschikbaar maken voor rapportages, analyses en informatieverstrekking. Het Douane Dataplatform (DDP) speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Het koppelen van data en het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde algoritmes, zodat risico’s via scan-, detectie en camerasystemen kunnen worden gedetecteerd. Door regie op het eigen netwerk uit te voeren wordt de effectiviteit op het toezicht van goederen en de veiligheid vergroot. Het digitaliseren van de centrale informatievoorziening van de Douane. Dat Doen Ze Met De Teams Data Rapid application development Digitalisering Sensoren Sensoren Structurele inrichting van een volwaardig team om de aanschaf, gebruik en het beheer van IT-systemen voor de verschillende sensormiddelen te faciliteren of uit te voeren. Scan- & detectiemiddelen en andere sensoren integreren in het informatielandschap van de Douane.Hierdoor kan data samen met reguliere data gebruikt worden voor geavanceerde algoritmiek. Zorgen voor een robuust en veilig netwerk rond de verschillende sensoren, zodat de Douane een optimaal veiligheidsniveau kan garanderen. De organisatie Douane De Douane is een handhavingsdienst, stelt de verschuldigde douanerechten en accijnzen vast en heft en int deze. De geïnde bedragen worden afgedragen aan de Nederlandse schatkist en de EU. De Douane zorgt er ook voor dat de samenleving zo goed mogelijk wordt beschermd tegen onveilige en ongewenste goederen. Hieronder valt een breed scala aan taken op het terrein van veiligheid, milieu, flora en fauna, gezondheid en cultuur. Én de Douane draagt bij aan het versterken van de concurrentiepositie van Nederland en de EU door toe te zien op de naleving van Europese maatregelen voor marktordening en te zorgen voor een snelle en goede douaneafhandeling, resulterend in zo min mogelijk oponthoud en lage administratieve lasten. Het werkterrein van de Douane is opgedeeld in landelijke directies en bureaus, het Douane Dienstencentrum (DDC), het Douane Landelijk Tactisch Centrum (DLTC) en acht regiokantoren. De regiokantoren bevinden zich in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Breda, Groningen, Arnhem, Eindhoven en op twee locaties op de luchthaven Schiphol. De landelijke directies en bureaus zien toe op de eenheid van beleid en uitvoering op het gebied van handhaving, operaties, financiën en control, informatievoorziening en mens en middelen. Daarnaast bewaken zij de samenhang binnen Douane Nederland. Het DLTC stuurt de handhaving aan op basis van risicobeheersing. De informatietechnologie-keten zorgt voor de veiligheid, stabiliteit en continuïteit van de IT-dienstverlening. Het DDC levert producten en diensten op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering aan de douanekantoren. Bijzonderheden We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee. Onze selectieprocedure voor deze functie ziet er als volgt uit: Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor deze functie. Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie-eisen. Selectiegesprekken worden in overleg ingepland. Onderaan deze vacature vind je meer uitleg over de stappen die je doorloopt in de sollicitatieprocedure. De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel de genoemde kennis en werkervaring als op het opleidingsniveau. Vermeld deze daarom duidelijk in je cv. De Douane zet zich in voor de banenafspraak: zoveel mogelijk banen realiseren voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking. Val jij in deze doelgroep? Wij zullen je ondersteunen zodat je optimaal kunt functioneren, en daarmee jouw bijdrage aan Nederland kunt leveren. Of het nu gaat om aanpassingen op je werkplek, bepaalde voorzieningen in het vervoer of bijvoorbeeld vergoedingen van het UWV: samen met jou, je leidinggevende én een jobcoach gaan wij kijken naar jouw kwaliteiten en mogelijkheden om een passend werkpakket uit te voeren. Wil jij weten of je hierbij hoort en wat dit exact betekent voor jou? Lees hier meer. Een (online) voorselectietest en/of een assessment kan deel uit maken van de sollicitatieprocedure, evenals het maken van een casus, het opvragen van referenties en (online) screening, bijvoorbeeld via databanken, (zoekmachines) en sociale netwerken. Jouw sollicitatie wordt alleen in behandeling genomen als je met de sollicitatie-button reageert en je cv en motivatiebrief zijn bijgesloten. Na sluitingsdatum is het niet meer mogelijk om je sollicitatie in behandeling te nemen. Houd er rekening mee dat het solliciteren technische problemen met zich mee kan brengen. Wacht hiermee dus niet tot het laatste moment. Wanneer je solliciteert op een functie maak je eenmalig een account aan. Met je account kan je de status van je sollicitatie inzien. Het genoemde telefoonnummer is uitsluitend bestemd voor sollicitanten en andere belangstellenden. Acquisitie door commerciële partijen wordt niet in behandeling genomen.

review_candidates.title: Global Engineering Center - Transformation Leader
review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary The Global Engineering Competency Center (GECC) India - with teams in Noida and Chennai - is at the heart of Grid Automation’s Engineering ambition. GECC India is embarking on a bold transformation journey to evolve from an engineering back-office into a world-class Global Solutions Center that delivers high quality, scalable, cost-competitive and harmonized solutions across all GA regions globally. The GECC Transformation Leader will serve as the architect and catalyst of this change - partnering with the relevant functional leaders & Regional teams to build a scalable, high-performing, globally trusted Global Solutions Center in India. This role demands a combination of Strategic vision, Operational rigor, Stakeholder inﬂuence, Talent / People Growth mindset and Change leadership - someone who can implement transformation while delivering measurable business outcomes – including 3x improvement of HCR:BCR mix. Job Description Build the Global Engineering Centre That Will Define How GE Vernova Delivers at Scale GE Vernova's Grid Automation (GA) business is ready to take its Global Engineering Competency Centre (GECC) in India — with teams in Noida and Chennai — to an entirely new level. The ambition is clear: evolve GECC India from an engineering support function into a world-class Global Solutions Centre that delivers high-quality, scalable, cost-competitive, and harmonised engineering solutions across all GA regions worldwide. As GECC Transformation Leader, you will be the architect and principal driver of that evolution. This is a senior People Leader role with individual contributor depth — combining strategic organisational design, cross-regional stakeholder engagement, operational performance leadership, and talent development into a single, high-accountability mandate. You will partner with functional leaders and regional teams across the globe to design, execute, and embed a transformation that reshapes how GE Vernova engineers and delivers for its customers. If you want a role where your decisions shape an entire organisation — and where the outcomes you deliver will be measured, visible, and lasting — this is it. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end transformation strategy and execution — own the full phased transformation roadmap from initial strategy approval through to full Global Solutions Centre readiness, ensuring milestones are met at each governance stage; drive change management adoption across all levels of the organisation; lead GECC India's evolution from design and configuration support to full project engineering ownership. Build and manage stakeholder alignment — develop and execute a comprehensive Voice of Customer (VoC) programme across all GA regions to understand pain points, build trust, and design the transformation roadmap; establish and manage a Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) framework covering workload forecasting and rolling annual commitments between regions and GECC; and facilitate regular cross-regional collaboration forums, face-to-face workshops, and governance reviews to ensure sustained partnership and executive sponsorship. Drive operational excellence and quality — define, implement, and track core operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs); lead the development and implementation of a Quality Framework across regions and GECC to close delivery gaps; champion AI-powered process automation and digital engineering tools to unlock productivity gains; and drive lean, standardised, and automated engineering processes that eliminate non-harmonised workflows. Lead capability building and talent strategy — partner with Human Resources (HR) and Talent Acquisition to attract and retain engineering talent in line with the growth plan; develop a structured capability assessment and ramp-up plan including training academies, knowledge transfer from regional teams, and induction programmes; establish clear career pathways and progression frameworks to support talent retention; and coordinate with the GSW GDC Romania team for leadership coaching, knowledge exchange, and capability benchmarking. Design and support the organisation — design and evolve a scalable, sustainable organisational model for GECC India; develop a formal service catalogue with defined scope, change control processes, and delivery standards; implement structured progress reporting for the Steering Committee and Executive Leadership; proactively identify and mitigate transformation risks; and provide leadership support to GECC India during the transformation phase as required. Who We're Looking For You're a senior transformation and engineering operations leader with a track record of building high-performing, globally distributed engineering organisations — someone who combines strategic clarity with operational discipline and genuine investment in developing the people around them. Required A formal education in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline provides a strong foundation for this role; however, we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements. Major experience in engineering, technology, or operations environments, with significant experience specifically in transformation, change management, or engineering and operations leadership roles. Demonstrated experience managing large-scale, multi-stakeholder transformation programmes in a global engineering or technology environment. Proven ability to influence senior leaders, regional stakeholders, and cross-functional teams across multiple geographies and cultures. Solid understanding of Grid Automation, Power Systems, or Industrial Automation engineering domains. Commitment to developing people — with a demonstrated ability to define, build, and develop high-performing management teams. Strong commercial and financial acumen — ability to build, track, and defend business cases in a global context. Experience leading geographically distributed, multicultural teams across multiple time zones. Preferred Experience setting up or scaling a Global Delivery Centre (GDC) or Engineering Centre of Excellence (CoE). Familiarity with Grid Automation products and solutions. Practical knowledge of Lean, Agile, and perform-while-you-transform operating principles. Expertise in people coaching, mentoring, and train-the-trainer delivery models. Experience in AI adoption, intelligent automation, or digital engineering tools in an industrial engineering context. Understanding of engineering talent market dynamics in India. Certifications in Project Management Professional (PMP), Change Management (Prosci or Association of Change Management Professionals (ACMP)), or Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt). Proficiency in KPI dashboards and operational governance tools. Why GE Vernova GE Vernova is a global energy technology company on a mission to electrify and decarbonise the world. Our Grid Automation business delivers the digital and automation solutions that make modern, resilient energy networks possible — and GECC India is set to become a cornerstone of how we engineer and scale those solutions globally. GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. We offer varied, competitive benefits designed to reward performance and support your personal and family needs. We invest in your development through continued on-the-job learning, and in a role like this — building an organisation from the inside out — your own growth will be inseparable from the transformation you lead. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes This is a remote position

review_candidates.title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d)
review_candidates.description: Your Mission at plancraft We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day. Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers. This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems. We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build. Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate. Your Responsibilities AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo. The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently. Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value. How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation. How you'll work & influence We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets. You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start: Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions. Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in. Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team. Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count. Your Profile Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership. Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine. Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one. Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about. Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes. Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority. AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively. A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area. C1 English. German is a plus, not a must. Prior experience building AI or ML capabilities is a huge plus — including work from before the LLM era — but it's not a fixed requirement. Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework. Who this role is for This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction. You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option. Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization. Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams. We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role. What You’ll Do Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory. Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts. Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities. Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies. Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates. Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast. Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts. What You’ll Bring Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills. Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities. Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes. Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values. Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure. Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools. Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication. Previous tech industry experience or experience in sales development, marketing, or sales is a plus. About The Team As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

review_candidates.title: Business Development Executive - EU Public Sector & NATO
review_candidates.description: Job Description 🌍We’re making security suck less for developers & CISOs Security tools interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck. Aikido builds developer-first products that cut real risk without getting in the way of shipping. Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, with $85M in the bank. Aikido Strategic & Defense (ASD) , our public sector and defense unit, is hiring its first Business Development Executive (EU Public Sector, Defense & NATO) . This is a zero-to-one, quota-carrying mandate: you drive and close out our first revenue in the region, then turn those wins into a repeatable motion. You will be measured on closed revenue first. Strategy, positioning, and partner work exist because they are how deals close here, not as a substitute for closing them. A team comes later, once the number is proven. This is a cyber-first role: developer tooling experience helps, but it is not what earns credibility in an MoD cyber unit. Who You Will Sell To Government and defense institutions themselves, not the defense industrial base: ministries of defense, national cyber commands and CERTs, public agencies, and NATO bodies like the NCI Agency. Three profiles, three entry points: In-house developers: The Aikido core platform, mapped to sovereign and mission outcomes. Few developers, GSI delivery team: Core platform plus supply chain security, sold through the integrator shipping the code. MoD and national cyber units: Autonomous pentesting, Box, and the offensive portfolio alongside defensive coverage. Cyber risk buyers, not engineering buyers. Job Requirements Drive and Close Out Our First Revenue: Carry the number and own the full cycle, from first touch through security review and procurement to signature. You source your pipeline and close it. Localize the ASD Strategy: Turn our global strategy into EU positioning and account plans that hold up with sovereign buyers. Define Joint GTM With Partners: Build go-to-market plans with GSIs, regional partners, and distributors holding government frameworks, and hold them accountable for pipeline. Navigate Public Procurement: Lead tenders, RFPs, and RFIs, and build the executive relationships behind them, from CISOs and national cyber leadership to procurement directors. Forecast accurately in HubSpot. Be Part of the Conversation: Operate inside the circles where European defense and cyber decisions get shaped. Credibility here is a deliverable, not a nice-to-have. What We Are Looking For Cybersecurity Depth First: Credible on both sides of the house, AppSec and supply chain on defense, pentesting and adversary tradecraft on offense, with a view on how AI is reshaping both. You Speak Acronym: Fluent in the language of this customer base and alive to the nuances here: budget and program cycles, classification boundaries, competing coalition and national interests, and when a slow process means caution, not disinterest. A Closer, Not Just an Opener: 8 to 12 years selling cybersecurity into the EU public sector, defense, or NATO, with a personally attributable record of closing 6- and 7-figure deals. Deep knowledge of government purchasing frameworks and partner-led models. A Network You Can Use Day One: Relationships across European MoDs, national cyber agencies, NATO bodies, or the partners serving them. Clearance, Languages, Location: Eligibility to obtain EU/NATO clearance; an active clearance is not required. Fluent English, with French, German, or Dutch a major plus. Based in Europe near government hubs, Brussels preferred. Why This Matters to Us These institutions protect citizens and support warfighters. The software they run on is a live target, and insecure code here lands on real people, not a risk register. If you want real impact, this is the seat. If it is just another territory, it is not. What You Can Expect A founding mandate for ASD in Europe with direct access to leadership. Short decision lines, big ownership, room to ship fast. Compensation and equity benchmarked to the mandate rather than the title, with real upside on the deals you close. Latitude on how you present yourself in the market. High trust, flexible hours, zero corporate BS. We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

new_matches.description: Ben je net als wij ook gepassioneerd over de toekomst en potentie van sensordata en AI en vind jij het leuk om te werken op de meest speciale locaties die je maar kunt bedenken? Wil jij meebouwen aan het IT-fundament voor de inzet van drones, camera’s, laboratorium en x-ray scanners? Lees dan vooral snel verder! Dit doe je bij de Douane Als Technisch Specialist netwerk & infrastructuur is het jouw kerntaak om ons sensorennetwerk en de bijbehorende infrastructuur 24/7 veilig en beschikbaar te houden. Als Douane Operaties voeren we op verschillende locaties in ons land actief controles uit om de goederen die Europa en Nederland binnenkomen elke dag weer te controleren. Hiervoor zetten wij verschillende apparatuur in als drones, camera’s, detectiepoorten en x-ray scanners. Het is jouw taak om ervoor te zorgen dat deze apparatuur kan aansluiten op een veilige netwerkinfrastructuur. Jij bent namelijk samen met jouw team verantwoordelijk voor het dagelijkse onderhoud en de inrichting van dit netwerk. Je werkt in het team Sensoren dat onderdeel uitmaakt van de Douane ICT afdeling Data en Digitalisering. Het team bestaat o.a. uit architecten, product owners, business analisten, netwerk-, videocamera-, AI-en data-specialisten. Op de maandag hebben we een team dag in Utrecht, de rest van de week wordt ingevuld door een mix van bezoeken en afspraken op locaties en thuiswerken. Wat jouw werk ontzettend leuk maakt is dat je dagelijks schakelt met enthousiaste Douane collega’s die net als jou de ambities hebben om onze controlewerkzaamheden elke dag weer een stukje beter te maken. Dit doen we mede aan de hand van nieuwe technologische mogelijkheden die we willen inzetten. Zo hebben we als Douane de ambitie om sensordata die uit de controleapparatuur komt, beschikbaar te maken voor analyse, verslaglegging en de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde algoritmes en/of AI-modellen. Hieronder Een Concreet Overzicht Van Jouw Taken En Verantwoordelijkheden Adviseren en ondersteunen van Douane Operaties bij complexe vraagstukken over het inrichten, beveiligen en onderhouden van de netwerkinfrastructuur en draadloze connectiviteit; Beheren van firewalls, WAN-, VPN- en MiFi-omgevingen en het borgen van netwerkbeveiliging; Oplossen van netwerkbeveiligingsincidenten en het uitvoeren van root-cause analyses; Ontwikkelen van monitoring en beheer op afstand; Opzetten, configureren en beheren van netwerkinfrastructuur apparatuur; Monitoren van prestaties, capaciteit en beschikbaarheid en proactief verbeteren waar nodig; Oplossen, analyseren en voorkomen van storingen; Meedraaien in de piketregeling van het team. Een bijzondere baan, omdat... Je er met je team voor verantwoordelijk bent dat onze fysieke controlewerkzaamheden 24/7 doorgang kunnen vinden; Je aan de wieg staat van het nieuw inrichten van onze sensor netwerkinfrastructuur; Je dagelijks bezig mag zijn met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van beveiliging en netwerken; Geen dag gelijk is en je in deze rol dagelijks op de meest interessante plekken komt. Te denken valt bijvoorbeeld aan de Rotterdamse Haven, Schiphol en de haven van Vlissingen. “De Douane zet volop in op nieuwe technologie, zo spelen we binnen ons team een sleutelrol bij de inzet van onze sensoren zoals drones en scanapparatuur. Dat geeft me binnen de Douane veel uitdaging en alle mogelijkheden om mezelf verder te ontwikkelen." Cor, team infra & sensoren Wanneer past deze baan bij je? Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau, een rijbewijs B en overzicht op netwerkinfrastructuur en gekoppelde systemen; Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met het ontwerpen, inrichten, beveiligen en testen van netwerkinfrastructuur; Je hebt kennis van routing, switching, firewalling, netwerkprotocollen, netwerkarchitecturen en data diodes; Je bent in het bezit van een CCNA-certificering (of vergelijkbaar) of bent bereid deze te behalen; Je hebt kennis van securitystandaarden en -principes zoals NIS2, BIO, ABRO, Zero Trust en ISO 27001/27002; Je hebt basiskennis van Microsoft besturingssystemen, storage-oplossingen (SAN/NAS) en camerasystemen; Je hebt interesse in of affiniteit met industriële automatisering en slimme sensoren. Wat vinden we nog meer belangrijk Je hebt een proactieve houding die zichtbaar is in jouw optreden. Je bent communicatief vaardig, enthousiast, flexibel en vakkundig. Je sociale vaardigheden zijn uitstekend en je beweegt je gemakkelijk binnen en buiten jouw netwerk. En omdat integriteit een belangrijke waarde is voor de Douane, is dit in al jouw handelen zichtbaar. Kortom: je bent een plezierige collega en het visitekaartje van de Douane. Jouw competenties analyseren plannen en organiseren voortgangscontrole resultaatgerichtheid samenwerken De afdeling - Douane Directie Informatietechnologie IT Data & Digitalisering (IT D&D) levert producten en diensten op het gebied van data, sensors en bijbehorende functionaliteit om de Douane processen te ondersteunen. Hiermee maken ze het fundament om datagedreven werken mogelijk te maken, zodat waardevolle beslissingen genomen kunnen worden op basis van volledige, juiste en tijdige informatie. Ze verbeteren daarnaast ook de digitale dienstverlening, zodat bedrijven volledig digitaal zaken kunnen doen met de Douane. Het maakt daarbij niet uit via welk kanaal ze in contact zijn met de douane, de gebruikerservaring is uniform en op elkaar afgestemd. De Kerntaken Van IT Data & Digitalisering Zijn Waarde leveren voor de Douane organisatie door IT-applicaties en producten op een snelle, effectieve en breed inzetbare manier te ontwikkelen. Gegevens uit interne en externe bronnen actueel en in samenhang beschikbaar maken voor rapportages, analyses en informatieverstrekking. Het Douane Dataplatform (DDP) speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Het koppelen van data en het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde algoritmes, zodat risico’s via scan-, detectie en camerasystemen kunnen worden gedetecteerd. Door regie op het eigen netwerk uit te voeren wordt de effectiviteit op het toezicht van goederen en de veiligheid vergroot. Het digitaliseren van de centrale informatievoorziening van de Douane. Dat Doen Ze Met De Teams Data Rapid application development Digitalisering Sensoren Sensoren Structurele inrichting van een volwaardig team om de aanschaf, gebruik en het beheer van IT-systemen voor de verschillende sensormiddelen te faciliteren of uit te voeren. Scan- & detectiemiddelen en andere sensoren integreren in het informatielandschap van de Douane.Hierdoor kan data samen met reguliere data gebruikt worden voor geavanceerde algoritmiek. Zorgen voor een robuust en veilig netwerk rond de verschillende sensoren, zodat de Douane een optimaal veiligheidsniveau kan garanderen. De organisatie Douane De Douane is een handhavingsdienst, stelt de verschuldigde douanerechten en accijnzen vast en heft en int deze. De geïnde bedragen worden afgedragen aan de Nederlandse schatkist en de EU. De Douane zorgt er ook voor dat de samenleving zo goed mogelijk wordt beschermd tegen onveilige en ongewenste goederen. Hieronder valt een breed scala aan taken op het terrein van veiligheid, milieu, flora en fauna, gezondheid en cultuur. Én de Douane draagt bij aan het versterken van de concurrentiepositie van Nederland en de EU door toe te zien op de naleving van Europese maatregelen voor marktordening en te zorgen voor een snelle en goede douaneafhandeling, resulterend in zo min mogelijk oponthoud en lage administratieve lasten. Het werkterrein van de Douane is opgedeeld in landelijke directies en bureaus, het Douane Dienstencentrum (DDC), het Douane Landelijk Tactisch Centrum (DLTC) en acht regiokantoren. De regiokantoren bevinden zich in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Breda, Groningen, Arnhem, Eindhoven en op twee locaties op de luchthaven Schiphol. De landelijke directies en bureaus zien toe op de eenheid van beleid en uitvoering op het gebied van handhaving, operaties, financiën en control, informatievoorziening en mens en middelen. Daarnaast bewaken zij de samenhang binnen Douane Nederland. Het DLTC stuurt de handhaving aan op basis van risicobeheersing. De informatietechnologie-keten zorgt voor de veiligheid, stabiliteit en continuïteit van de IT-dienstverlening. Het DDC levert producten en diensten op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering aan de douanekantoren. Bijzonderheden We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. new_matches.title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d)
new_matches.description: Your Mission at plancraft We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day. Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers. This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems. We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build. Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate. Your Responsibilities AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo. The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently. Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value. How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation. How you'll work & influence We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets. You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start: Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions. Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in. Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team. Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count. Your Profile Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership. Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine. Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one. Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about. Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes. Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority. AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively. A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area. C1 English. German is a plus, not a must. Prior experience building AI or ML capabilities is a huge plus — including work from before the LLM era — but it's not a fixed requirement. Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework. Who this role is for This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction. You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option. Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.
